userStories.title: Generate sprint stories for context-matching focus area
userStories.notes: Seed story - generated 11 implementation stories (US-70-002 through US-70-012) covering video metadata extraction, context-enriched matching, chapter detection, listicle detection, cross-chapter grouping, and iterative match enhancements.

userStories.title: Add video metadata fields to CaptionResult and state dataclasses
acceptanceCriteria: CaptionResult in src/caption/models.py has new fields: video_description (str, default ''), video_chapters (List[dict], default []), video_tags (List[str], default [])
VideoSearchResult in src/state.py has new field: description (str, default '')
DownloadedVideo in src/state.py has new field: description (str, default '')
Existing CaptionResult serialization/deserialization is backward compatible - cached results without new fields load without error
New fields have __post_init__ handling if needed for dict-vs-object safety (Rule 2, Rule 6)
Unit tests verify CaptionResult round-trip serialization with and without new fields
userStories.notes: All 6/6 criteria verified. Fields added with defaults, __post_init__ None-safety, to_dict serialization, backward compat tested via CachedCaption.to_caption_result() and dict reconstruction. 17 tests pass.

userStories.title: Extract video description, chapters, and tags from yt-dlp info_dict
acceptanceCriteria: caption_fetcher.py extracts info_dict['description'] (truncated to max_description_length, default 500 chars) and stores it in CaptionResult.video_description
caption_fetcher.py extracts info_dict['chapters'] (list of {title, start_time, end_time} dicts) and stores in CaptionResult.video_chapters
caption_fetcher.py extracts info_dict['tags'] (list of strings) and stores in CaptionResult.video_tags
When info_dict fields are missing or None, extraction gracefully defaults to empty string/list without raising errors
Unit tests verify extraction from a mock info_dict with all fields present, partially present, and completely absent
userStories.notes: All 5/5 criteria verified. extract_video_metadata_from_info_dict extracts description (truncated to 500), chapters (list of dicts), tags (list of strings). Graceful None/missing handling via isinstance checks and defaults. 16 tests pass: all-fields, partial, absent, None values, empty/None dict, truncation, chapter key defaults, tag None filtering, non-dict chapter skipping, enrich_with_metadata, to_dict serialization, __post_init__ None-safety.

userStories.title: Parse YouTube chapters from video description text
acceptanceCriteria: New function parse_description_chapters(description: str) -> List[dict] that extracts timestamp-title pairs from description text
Handles common YouTube description chapter formats: '0:00 Introduction', '01:23 Topic Name', '1:02:30 Long Topic'
Returns list of {title: str, start_time: float, end_time: float} dicts with end_time computed from next chapter's start_time
Returns empty list when no chapter pattern is detected or description is empty/None
caption_fetcher.py calls this function when info_dict['chapters'] is empty/missing and parse_description_chapters config is True
Unit tests cover: standard format, HH:MM:SS format, mixed formats, no chapters, malformed timestamps
userStories.notes: Tier: foundation (Area 1). Files: src/caption_fetcher.py (add parse function near info_dict handling), or new utility in src/caption/. Many YouTube videos have chapters only in the description, not in the structured chapters field. Regex pattern: r'(?:^|\n)\s*(\d{1,2}:?\d{2}(?::\d{2})?)\s+(.+?)(?=\n|$)'. Config gate: context_enrichment.parse_description_chapters.

userStories.title: Add title keyword overlap scoring to confidence adjustments
acceptanceCriteria: New method apply_title_relevance_adjustment() in MatchScoring class (src/matching/scoring.py) computes keyword overlap between voiceover segment text and video title
Graduated boost applied: 1 keyword match -> +0.03, 2 matches -> +0.05, 3+ matches -> +0.08
Adjustment recorded in confidence_breakdown as {'component': 'title_relevance', 'adjustment': <value>, 'reason': <detail>}
apply_all_adjustments() calls apply_title_relevance_adjustment() when video title is available
No adjustment applied when video title is empty or None (graceful no-op)
Unit tests verify graduated boost values and confidence_breakdown entry format
userStories.notes: All 6/6 criteria verified. 10 unit tests passing. Implementation at scoring.py:2044-2115, tests at test_matching_scoring.py:1615-1747.

userStories.title: Enrich LLM reranker prompt with video title and description context
acceptanceCriteria: LLMReranker.rerank() in src/matching/llm_reranker.py includes video title in candidate descriptions sent to LLM
When video description is available, first sentence (up to 100 chars) is appended as context: 'Video context: {title}. {first_sentence}'
Candidate format changes from simple pipe-separated text to include metadata prefix
When title/description are empty, format falls back to current behavior (caption text only)
Unit tests verify prompt construction with and without video context
userStories.notes: HARD STORY: Skipped after 3_failures - pending decomposition

userStories.title: Prepend video title to caption text for title-enriched embeddings
acceptanceCriteria: In src/stages/caption_stage.py _populate_text_metadata(), when context_enrichment.title_enriched_embeddings is True, prepend '[{video_title}] ' to segment text before embedding computation
Original caption text is preserved separately for display/matching - only embedding input is modified
When video title is empty or config is disabled, behavior is identical to current (no prefix added)
Config toggle matching.context_enrichment.title_enriched_embeddings controls this behavior with getattr fallback
Unit tests verify embedding text construction with and without title prefix
userStories.notes: Implementation committed in fac7f9e. _populate_text_metadata prepends [title] to embedding_text when title_enriched_embeddings=True. 9 unit tests pass covering enabled/disabled/empty-title/dict-results scenarios.

userStories.title: Map caption segments to YouTube chapters for chapter-aware scoring
acceptanceCriteria: New function map_segments_to_chapters(segments, chapters) returns a dict mapping segment index to chapter index/title
Segments spanning chapter boundaries are assigned to the chapter with the most temporal overlap
Segments outside all chapter ranges are assigned chapter_index=-1 (no chapter)
New scoring adjustment apply_chapter_topic_match() in MatchScoring adds +0.05 to +0.10 boost when voiceover and video chapter topics match, -0.05 penalty for mismatch
Adjustment recorded in confidence_breakdown as 'chapter_topic_match' entry
Unit tests cover: exact boundary segments, spanning segments, segments outside chapters, empty chapters list
userStories.notes: Tier: enhancement (Area 3). Files: src/matching/scoring.py (add apply_chapter_topic_match method to MatchScoring class), new utility function can go in src/chapter_detection/models.py or src/chapter_detection/. Depends on US-70-002/003 for chapter data availability. Chapter topic matching uses keyword overlap between chapter titles and voiceover segment keywords.

userStories.title: Detect listicle structure in voiceover narration
acceptanceCriteria: New module src/chapter_detection/listicle_detector.py with detect_listicle_groups(segments) function
Detects ordinal markers ('first', 'second', 'third', 'finally', 'lastly') at segment boundaries
Detects numbered markers ('#1', 'number one', 'step 1', 'item 1') at segment starts
Detects transition markers ('next up', 'moving on to', 'let\'s talk about') between segments
Returns List[ListicleGroup] where ListicleGroup has: group_id, item_label, start_segment_idx, end_segment_idx, topic_keywords
Unit tests verify detection of each marker type and edge case of mixed numbering styles
userStories.notes: Tier: enhancement (Area 4). Files: new src/chapter_detection/listicle_detector.py. The chapter_detection/ directory already exists with detector.py, models.py, chunking.py, and passes/. ListicleGroup dataclass can go in src/chapter_detection/models.py. Integration with existing chapter detection (detector.py) is a separate story. This story focuses on the detection logic only.

userStories.title: Add chapter-level source consistency boost to scoring
acceptanceCriteria: New method apply_chapter_source_consistency() in MatchScoring class applies +0.03 boost when candidate video source matches previous segment's source within the same voiceover chapter
consecutive_source_penalty is suppressed (not applied) for segments within the same voiceover chapter boundary when chapter_grouping is enabled
When chapter structure is not available, existing consecutive_source_penalty behavior is unchanged
New config field matching.chapter_grouping.source_consistency_boost (float, default 0.03) controls boost amount
Adjustment recorded in confidence_breakdown as 'chapter_source_consistency' entry
Unit tests verify boost application within chapters and penalty suppression logic
userStories.notes: Tier: enhancement (Area 3/5). Files: src/matching/scoring.py (apply_consecutive_source_penalty and MatchScoring class), src/config/sections/matching.py (add chapter_grouping config section with ChapterGroupingConfig dataclass), config.yaml. Depends on chapter detection (US-70-009/010) for knowing chapter boundaries. The insight is that within a coherent section about one topic, using multiple clips from the same video is actually desirable, not penalizable.

userStories.title: Add description-derived search queries to iterative gap filling
acceptanceCriteria: gap_analyzer.py extracts key phrases from video descriptions of already-matched videos when analyzing gaps
Extracted phrases are used to generate additional targeted search queries for gap-filling iterations
New config field iterative_match.use_description_queries (bool, default True) controls this behavior
When no descriptions are available or config is disabled, gap analysis behavior is unchanged
Unit tests verify query generation from mock descriptions and graceful no-op when descriptions are absent
userStories.notes: Tier: polish (Area 6). Files: src/iterative_match/gap_analyzer.py (analyze_gaps function at lines 152-212), src/config/sections/iterative_matching.py (add use_description_queries field). Depends on US-70-002/003 for description availability. Key phrase extraction can use simple NLP: extract noun phrases or TF-IDF keywords from descriptions. This enriches the iterative match search space beyond the voiceover text alone.
